description.zh: 基础镜像标签，仅管控节点使用。
description.en: The image tag of the operating system. The tag is used only for management nodes.

description.zh:
集群ID。

- 如果指定集群ID，则查询集群所在地域下的所有镜像列表。
- 如果不指定集群ID，则默认查询所有集群支持的镜像列表。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

*   If you specify a value for this parameter, all community images in the region where the cluster resides are queried.
*   If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the community images that are supported by all clusters are queried.

description.zh:
镜像来源。取值范围：
- self：自定义镜像
- others：共享镜像
description.en:
The image source. Valid values:

*   self: custom image
*   others: shared image

description.zh: 指定实例规格。如果不指定实例规格，则默认查询所有实例规格支持的镜像列表。
description.en: The instance type of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. If you do not specify the instance type, the community images that are supported by all instance types are queried.

title.zh: 查询自定义和共享的镜像列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc list-custom-images --image-owner-alias self --base-os-tag CentOS_7.2_64 --instance-type ecs.n1.tiny --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
